text_block_list.text: One day, I bring <chrname> to the infirmary for a checkup.
Oh! A custo—I mean, a student! Hello!
Are you hurt? Sick? Stressed? Whatever it is, I treat it all!
Well, considering you're at the academy infirmary, I'd say that makes me your trusty school nurse! Yup, just your average school employee!
Ahaha! Guess there's no fooling you. I suppose I should start by giving you my name.
Ahem! Allow me to introduce myself!
I am the (likely) savior of all Umamusume, the (self-proclaimed) legendary acupuncturist with the magic touch…

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: The one and only Sasami Anshinzawa! See? No worries! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Her acting's pretty good, I'll give her that. Anyway, should we report her?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Gosh! You sure seem worried! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: No matter! No matter! We've made our introductions, so lie down and let me put these needles to work!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hang on, now! Don't you think you're going a bit fast?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! No need to be scared! All I'm going to do is slip these extraordinary needles precisely into your chakra points.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Then voilà, presto! Something indescribable will happen!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: And let me assure you, there's absolutely nothing sketchy about this at all! It's never gone anything less than perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: …For my master.
choice_data_list: For your master?! What about for you?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Don't fret! This is my first time, so technically, I've never failed a patient either!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: And it's not like I have no experience! I spent ten years under a legendary master, fetching dri—I mean, training!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: See? No worries! ☆
choice_data_list: (We need to get outta here, stat!)

text_block_list.text: There's no way we're doing this. I take <chrname> and head for the door, when…

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: W-wait! Where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: You're Fuji Kiseki, right?! Leader of Ritto Dorm, charmer of fans with your clever acts, and most lovable of entertainers?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Have I heard of her? Of course I have! I'm a big fan!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: That's precisely why I'm here! To give you my support! Let me help you!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Just give me a chance! Pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm… To trust you or flee right now, that is the question…

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Please! Pretty please with a carrot on top! I'll even let you choose which chakra I activate!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I won't mess up!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Well… pretty sure.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I mean, it's on the sure side! That's good, right? Anyway, don't get hung up on the details!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Let's get to the good stuff! Which chakra should I activate? Do you want a boost to your abilities? Your health? Or maybe your charm?
I smell danger in the air, but I figure there might—and I emphasize might—be a chance of getting something special out of this treatment.
What should we do?
choice_data_list: This is too sketchy. Let's quit while we still can.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. So you want me to activate the strength chakra?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Then let's get started! Are you ready? There's no going back after!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: All right, leave it to me! Time to locate that chakra! Ollie, ollie, oxen free!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Now, just relaaax… See? No worries! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Aaand poke!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ngh?!
Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What an exhilarating sensation! It's almost as if my senses have been whetted to full keenness!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Waves of inspiration are washing over me! I feel like I've been born anew!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Gasp… You're kidding… It actually worked?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: No waaay! I can't believe it! I'm a total genius!
<chrname> is overflowing with so much power she's almost unrecognizable!
We took a chance and it paid off! This is a great leap toward achieving our goal!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm… Hmmm? My body… is so heavy…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My arms and legs… feel like lead… Urgh…
<chrname>'s condition deteriorates rapidly.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: So… That's that, I guess…

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Well, would you look at the time? I should get going! Bye! ☆
I should've known better than to test our luck. I'm not the one suffering, yet I'm full of regret.

I'm curious who this Anshinzawa character really is, but there's no use ruminating over it. Best to forget about today and move on.

text_block_list.text: Had a change of heart, did you? No worries, it happens!
